name_reason: Fully compliant with the global naming convention: data_fd2_ prefix (game global data), chapter domain, ch03 is a meaningful chapter ID (chapters 01-30, must be preserved, not an address residue), descriptor end_scene_char_pos_x reflects use (chapter-3 end-scene per-character X tile coordinate), _table suffix reflects the array data type. No Ghidra address residue (the address is 0x520ba; no hex suffix matches it).
purpose: Chapter 3 end-scene character placement: per-character X tile coordinate for the 7 characters staged in the chapter-3 recruit cutscene (recruit char #2, the swordsman).
logic_summary: First of three parallel 7-byte tables (X @ 0x520ba, Y @ 0x520c1, facing @ 0x520c8). Sole reader fd2_chapter_03_end @ 0x230f2 block-copies all 7 bytes (MOVSD/MOVSW/MOVSB) onto an on-stack character-placement block; the block is then passed as the X-position argument to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro. Each entry is consumed one byte at a time (recruit_block_a._0_1_ .. [6]); no struct stride, no wider element access, no sign extension. Values are small battle-tile X coords (6..10).
element_semantics: Per-character X tile coordinate (battle-grid column) for one of the 7 staged characters; value range 6..10. Index i = i-th staged character in the chapter-3 end cutscene.
notes: Memory bytes at 0x520ba = {8,7,9,6,10,8,8} match the src definition exactly; following bytes confirm the adjacent Y table {3,3,3,2,2,4,1} @ 0x520c1 and facing table {2,2,2,3,1,2,0} @ 0x520c8. Only 2 xrefs, both from fd2_chapter_03_end (DATA @ 0x23105, READ @ 0x2310a); no writer -> const confirmed. Existing src comment block (chtab.c lines 192-209) is already accurate and precise, so it was left unchanged (comment_verdict=keep). Ghidra plate for this data address was empty (null); a concise src-authoritative plate was created via run_script_inline + cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...). chtab.c was NOT modified by this refine.
